answer: A newcomer is admitted only when an unrelated sponsor stakes copper behind it, cipher-signed into the atlas, and every head one sponsor has vouched shares that single stake: one unmasked clone forfeits the whole pool, so the sponsor eats the bill. Sponsors price by total exposure — the k-th clone costs base×k copper per epoch — while a lone newcomer still pays plain base. Spreading clones across sponsors buys nothing; each fresh sponsor stakes the full pool.
